items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: I was supposed to go, with Benny Bailey and a German pianist, a wonderful pianist, Joe Heider.

ctx.x: And in Germany, at the Domicile, or -- I go up there quite often. As a matter of fact, I couldn't make it this year. September, I was supposed to go, with Benny Bailey and a German pianist, a wonderful pianist, Joe Heider.
